deterministic.reason: The compiled conventions map ran successfully.
The gate found untouched web docs, skills, and changelog surfaces. Contract-carrying docs and prompts are reported as a confirmed finding; historical changelogs are exempt.
Reverting the React implementation while retaining the new regression test made the test fail with path.startsWith is not a function.
Current main added repeat validation and per-item repeat filtering after the PR branch point. Both were tested in a temporary landing composition.

findings.claim: The PR cannot build against current main because validateSpec still passes the widened repeat.statePath union to getByPath as a string.
findings.evidence: A clean current-main @json-render/core build passes. After composing PR #256, the DTS build fails at packages/core/src/spec-validator.ts:142 with TS2345: string | { $item: string } is not assignable to string.

findings.claim: The public core type change breaks @json-render/svelte and Svelte does not implement nested repeat resolution.
findings.evidence: svelte-check fails at packages/svelte/src/RepeatChildren.svelte:23 because getByPath receives string | { $item: string }. The same file interpolates the object directly into basePath. Other changed renderer packages built after the core dependency was built.
findings.layer: cross-renderer public type and runtime parity

findings.claim: Using $item in repeat.statePath outside a repeat warns but then renders unrelated root state.
findings.evidence: A real React render with top-level repeat.statePath { $item: "items" } logged the warning and rendered state.items. Existing $item prop resolution returns undefined outside repeat scope, so the new resolver violates established semantics.

findings.claim: The new repeat resolver disagrees with existing $item path semantics for a leading slash.
findings.evidence: Existing $item values are passed to getByPath, which accepts both field and /field. The PR concatenates basePath + '/' + field, producing a double slash. A nested React render using { $item: "/subitems" } rendered no items.
findings.layer: rendered React behavior and RFC 6901 path resolution

findings.claim: The AI prompt and public documentation do not expose the feature.
findings.evidence: packages/core/src/schema.ts, packages/react/src/schema.ts, and apps/web docs continue to define repeat.statePath only as an absolute string JSON Pointer. The PR changes no README, web doc, or skill file.

findings.claim: catalog.validate still strips runtime fields such as repeat.
findings.evidence: The generated catalog schema does not declare repeat and Zod object parsing strips unknown keys. Existing issue #222 and PR #255 already track this.

exemptions.claim: Historical changelogs that mention repeat.statePath do not need retroactive syntax edits.
exemptions.evidence: Those passages document earlier releases and do not claim to be the current repeat contract.

exemptions.claim: No separate tests are required for unchanged action statePath parameters.
exemptions.evidence: The union applies only to UIElement.repeat.statePath and action parameters remain strings.
